description: Brand mentions people SAY but never type. search_mentions reads captions, post bodies and comments — text — so it does not see a brand named only out loud in a video. This reads the words actually spoken, from the platform's own caption track (not our own speech recognition — see get_post_transcript), and searches them for a term. Narrows to candidate posts first (a niche/keyword sweep, named creator handles, and/or your watchlist), transcribes only the most-viewed survivors up to a hard ceiling you set, and returns the matched line with surrounding context so tone can be judged. TikTok, YouTube and Douyin — the networks whose post detail already carries a caption track, so a transcript is read directly rather than waited for. Every other network's audio can be transcribed too, at the same price, but not yet from here: see get_post_transcript for that route. Even on these three a video whose creator disabled captions is invisible to this tool; coverage is real but partial, and the result says how many candidates were found, transcribed and matched so the gap is never silent. Costs 2 nooticr credits per platform a niche is searched on, 2 per creator handle checked (including ones added by useWatchlist), and 1 per transcript actually fetched — never more than `maxTranscripts` transcripts, whatever the candidate count. Above 6 credits worst-case it asks first, like search_mentions. Use when a term might be spoken on camera but not written anywhere; search_mentions is for what people typed.

candidateLimit.description: Posts pulled per narrowing call, before the transcript ceiling is applied (default 15, max 25). Finds more candidates at the same narrowing cost — does not raise transcript spend on its own.

maxTranscripts.description: Hard ceiling on transcripts fetched, at 1 credit each (default 8, max 20). The most-viewed candidates are read first, so lowering this trades completeness for cost rather than dropping posts at random.

niche.description: Niche or keyword for a candidate sweep, e.g. 'skincare'. Provide this, usernames, useWatchlist, or any combination — at least one is required.

platforms.description: Which networks to check (default: both). These are the only two whose posts carry a caption track this tool can read.

term.description: Brand, product or person to listen for, e.g. 'nooticr'. Matched case-insensitively on whole words, so 'nike' will not match inside 'nikeisha'.

useWatchlist.description: Also check your watchlisted creators who are on tiktok or youtube. Looking the list up is free; each creator it adds is still priced like any other handle.

usernames.description: Specific creator handles to check, with or without @. Checked on every platform in `platforms`.

name: search_spoken_mentions

candidatesConsidered.description: Candidate posts found by the narrowing step, before the ceiling.

ceilingReached.description: True when more candidates existed than the ceiling allowed to check.

evidenceFrom.description: The cheap calls this was assembled from.

frameIndex.description: Where each returned frame sits in the video.

guidance.description: What to do with this payload, in prose. Read it: it is the instruction, not a summary.

occurrence.description: Which match this is, 1-based. Only the first few carry an excerpt.

position.description: Character offset of the match inside the full transcript.

startMs.description: When it was said, from the caption track's own cue timings. Absent, never estimated, when the platform published no timings.

text.description: The spoken line, with surrounding context to judge tone from.

matchCount.description: Times the term appears in this transcript.

commentSample.description: The replies themselves, when they were read. Someone answering "same here, this is exactly my problem" under another person's thread is a better find than the thread — the permalink to quote is still this post's.

commentsRead.description: How many replies were read under this post. 0 means the thread would not open — not that nobody replied. Absent when nothing tried.

externalUrl.description: Permalink — the URL to feed back into another tool.

hits.description: Posts whose transcript names the term, loudest match first.

matched.description: Posts whose transcript actually names the term.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

mode.description: Always "evidence": this payload is material you have still to read.

niche.description: The keyword sweep asked for, if any.

platforms.description: Networks actually checked — tiktok and/or youtube.

posts.description: The hits' posts, flattened for the card view.

estimated.description: true when the audio length was estimated rather than reported.

speechToTextUsage.description: Present only on a call that transcribed audio; a cached or caption answer carries none.

transcribed.description: Transcripts actually fetched — never more than maxTranscripts.

transcriptsAvailable.description: Of those, how many carried a caption track at all.

unavailable.description: Candidates that could not be narrowed or transcribed, with why.

usernames.description: Explicit creator handles asked for, if any.

watchlistChecked.description: Watchlisted creators added by useWatchlist, on tiktok or youtube.

title: Search Spoken Mentions
